author: Zato1
quote: It took Rockstar 13 years and 2 billion dollars to develop a game with gameplay full of bugs and storyline full of female fantasies. Shame on all the game media who give this game a 100/100 and claim it to be the best game in the history. I wasn’t expecting it to meet all the expectations, but the play through of this game is so underwhelming and doesn’t not feel like a GTA experience at all. 40 hours into this game and it genuinely plays like an unremarkable open world game, and it is not remotely close to be a good one. I would not suggest any one to waste $100 and 60 hours on playing this piece of trash. If you want a good Rockstar triple-A game experience, always go for GTA5 and RDR2 instead.
